subject: E-4133: token rejected on macOS
body:
Hello support team. We run PixelForge 6.0.3 on macOS 15.3.
Since Monday, every time I log in, I get "E-4133:
authentication token rejected".

IT forced a password reset for everyone last week. I changed
mine on the laptop but the app never asked again.

I've already tried waiting a day, which changed nothing.

Mei Lin -- Harbour Freight. Appreciate any pointers.
